children.value: > Fact From Story: Navigating external and domestic economic headwinds will not be an easy feat for the administration, but the private sector will be an important catalyst for sustainable development.

> > Fact From Story: With the private sector sharing industry knowledge, resources and potentially even leading certain socio-economic programs and projects of the National Government, it is to be hoped that AmBisyon Natin 2040 of long and healthy lives for Filipinos that are strongly rooted, comfortable, and secure will be achieved.
> > > Fact From Story: Likewise, investments in renewable energy are expected not only to enhance energy security but also reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions.
> > > Fact From Story: The government calls for embedding resilience, sustainability, and nature-based solutions in infrastructure planning and investment to enhance climate resilience.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Climate resilience, sustainability, and renewable energy contribute to sustainable development.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: The private sector has knowledge, resources, and leadership abilities.

> Fact From Story: Coming off from the pandemic and with the current global economic climate, it is opportune for the government to proactively drive for actionable policies and programs that focus on building the resiliency of the economy through sustainable development with greater emphasis given to addressing climate change.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Building the resiliency of the economy through sustainable development is a difficult task.
